scope: Re-read of the firm-level rules fields (drawdown type, maximum loss, consistency, profit split, payout frequency) plus the other fieldEvidence entries below, against the official pages listed. Every stored value matches the live pages; no product value changed. Product sourceCapturedAt stays 2026-10-20 (prices were re-read and match, but this capture is not a full product recapture).
accessNotes: Official Topstep pages only (www.topstep.com, help.topstep.com), plain HTTP fetch 2026-10-28 10:35–10:36 Riga (UTC+2), no VPN/proxy; quotes verbatim from the article body, whitespace-normalised; flattened table cells are joined with spaces.

phases.quote: It's a simulated account with one rule and two objectives. Meet them, and you've earned your Express Funded Account®
phases.interpretation: Single evaluation before XFA; no second evaluation target.

profitTargets.phase1.quote: Account Size Profit Target Best Day Recommendation $50K $3,000 Less than $1,650 $100K $6,000 Less than $3,300 $150K $9,000 Less than $4,950
profitTargets.phase1.interpretation: Flattened table cells. $3,000/$6,000/$9,000 at 50K/100K/150K, each normalised to 6%.

maxLossUsd.interpretation: Flattened table cells (Account Size / Maximum Loss Limit).

drawdownType.quote: The MLL is a trailing limit. It rises as your end-of-day balance grows, but never moves down. Once it reaches your starting balance, it locks permanently.
drawdownType.interpretation: End-of-day trailing, locks at start, monitored intraday including unrealised P&L.

dailyLossPct.quote: The Daily Loss Limit (DLL) is optional in the Trading Combine® and Express Funded Account® (XFA). It’s automatic in the Live Funded Account® (LFA).
dailyLossPct.interpretation: Optional dollar lockout ($1,000/$2,000/$3,000) in Combine and XFA; null, not zero.

consistencyRulePct.interpretation: Hard 55% line, no buffer; a larger best day increases the required target. XFA Consistency payout path uses 40%.

minTradingDays.quote: You can pass in as few as two days
minTradingDays.conflictingQuote: There’s no minimum time requirement to pass the Trading Combine®

maxTradingDays.quote: The subscription fee rebills monthly until you pass the Trading Combine® or cancel the subscription

profitSplitPct.interpretation: New entrant base; legacy first-$10K exception remains noted.

payoutFirstDays.quote: 5 winning days of $150+ Net P&L. Days don't need to be consecutive.
payoutFirstDays.interpretation: Conditional trading-day paths (5 winning days Standard / 3 trading days Consistency); calendar scalar null.

payoutFrequency.quote: Available during CME market hours: Sunday 5 PM CT – Friday 5 PM CT (excluding holidays)
payoutFrequency.interpretation: Requests open during CME hours once the qualifying-day conditions are met (after-qualifying-days), not on demand.

activationFeeUsd.quote: Standard Path — $149, charged once per XFA earned. No Activation Fee Path — $0.

products.productName: Trading Combine - No Activation Fee Path
